en.headline: Lee says five-year plan will lift livelihoods through long-term strategy
en.dek: Chief Executive John Lee posted on social media that the first Hong Kong five-year plan and the Policy Address will both be issued on 16 September, with the plan setting macro strategy and the address delivering annual concrete measures.
body: Chief Executive John Lee said on Sunday that the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region’s first five-year plan will use long-term development strategies to continue raising people’s livelihoods, while the annual Policy Address will introduce specific measures on housing, livelihood and healthcare.

Lee posted a short video on his social media page noting that both documents will be published on the same day, 16 September. He said the simultaneous release would help the public understand how the two documents complement each other.

He thanked members of the public for the valuable views submitted during the consultation period and said the government would summarise the feedback and incorporate it into the plan and the Policy Address to promote sustained economic development and continuous improvement in people’s lives.

zh.headline: 李家超：五年規劃以長策提升民生福祉 施政報告推具體措施
zh.dek: 行政長官李家超今日在社交平台表示，香港首個五年規劃將於9月16日與施政報告同日公布，規劃以長遠策略提升民生，施政報告則每年推出房屋、民生及醫療等具體措施。
body: 行政長官李家超今日在社交專頁表示，《香港第一個五年規劃》將透過長遠發展策略，持續提升民生福祉；而《施政報告》則每年推出改善房屋、民生及醫療等不同方面的具體措施。
他指出兩份文件將於9月16日同日公布，方便市民深入了解兩者相輔相成的關係。他感謝市民在公眾諮詢期提出寶貴意見，政府會總結意見並納入規劃和施政當中。
李家超強調特區政府會繼續秉持以民為本的施政理念，聚焦民生所需，推動經濟持續發展、民生不斷改善，攜手創造香港新機遇。
